limitations: The inner radius is asymptotic with explicit \(O(1/n)\) error, not an exact finite-order formula; general twists, unequal weights, arbitrary designs, all facet incidence classifications, and independent verification are outside the scope.
scientific_integrity: The root-defined limiting inradius and unique limiting latitude are analytically proved; finite tests are corroborative. The fourth vertical moment excludes higher design strength. The claim is not an assertion about arbitrary spherical designs. Earlier same-family results determine the original polytope radii but not the projection-body radius or brightness minimizer.
title: Sharp limiting brightness and outer contacts of two-ring spherical-design Minkowski polytopes
